admission.justification: A second preview registry or weaker scope check would lose the quality runner's capacity and candidate boundaries.

applicability: Background citation previews admitted through citation_fix mode=start or mode=poll.
conditions: Start requires dry_run=true and freezes any document selectors.
A supplied contract binds the admitted leaf candidate; without one the configured repository scope applies.
Poll repeats the same repository/scope with the run ID and no document selectors.
exclusions: Runtime restart or terminal eviction does not preserve a run.
A completed computation is not a clean-memory or acceptance verdict.
statement: Citation preview start and poll reuse the memory-quality run registry and scope validation; dry-run completion retains the synchronous preview fields except status and runId.
